workflowName: LDN Decks DataForSEO MCP SEO Enrichment
purpose: Define a safe n8n workflow blueprint for read-only DataForSEO MCP research on LDN Decks SEO, citation, SERP, competitor, and backlink context.
allowedUseCases: SERP checks for LDN Decks service-area pages
Competitor/domain context for LDN Decks only
Backlink/referring-domain enrichment for LDN Decks only
AI and LLM visibility checks for LDN Decks only
Business listing and citation checks for LDN Decks only
disallowedUseCases: Changing Google Ads, GTM, GA4, GHL, Vapi, Twilio, Vercel, or DataForSEO account settings
Generating paid ad activation decisions without manual review
Running broad crawls without cost caps
Mixing unrelated domains into the LDN Decks workflow

workflowPrompts.prompt: Use DataForSEO MCP in read-only mode to summarize SERP context for ldndecks.com priority deck service pages. Stay within the manifest cost caps and return findings only.
Use DataForSEO MCP in read-only mode to check business listing and citation context for LDN Decks and ldndecks.com. Do not include unrelated domains.
Use DataForSEO MCP in read-only mode to summarize backlink and referring-domain context for ldndecks.com only. Do not modify accounts or submit anything externally.

notes: Use the local MCP server when DATAFORSEO_SIMPLE_FILTER is needed.
Keep real credentials only in the operator environment or n8n credential store.
Do not commit n8n workflow exports that contain credentials.
This manifest is a blueprint, not an active workflow export.
